results.title: Vast last-mile network for a product with zero tolerance for a cold break
results.closest_fact_claim: Vadilal operates a Cold Chain Network comprising three manufacturing plants (Pundhra and Dharampur in Gujarat, and Bareilly in Uttar Pradesh) totaling a production capacity of 1.25 lakh litres per day, about 23 C&FA, more than 500 distributors, and over 40,000 retailers.
